about.title: AI-Powered Travel Planning
about.subtitle: VoyagerAI combines the power of AI with a beautiful, intuitive interface to create personalized travel itineraries in seconds. No more hours of research — just tell us where you want to go and we'll handle the rest.
about.agentsSubtitle: Eight specialized AI subagents work together under a central orchestrator
about.agentResearcherDesc: Gathers destination intelligence: events, weather, visa requirements, safety advisories, and pricing
about.agentConstraintAnalyzerDesc: Derives enforceable trip constraints from your budget, dietary needs, and group composition
about.agentRiskDetectorDesc: Identifies travel risks: seasonal closures, weather hazards, transit gaps, and safety advisories
about.agentMultiPlanGeneratorDesc: Creates 3 budget-tiered itinerary variants with cost breakdowns and a comparison matrix
about.agentValidatorDesc: Checks itineraries against budget, constraints, and internal consistency
about.agentQualityScorerDesc: Scores plans 0-100 against 10 quality criteria and auto-improves low-scoring plans
about.agentCostOptimizerDesc: Optimizes over-budget itineraries with accommodation swaps, activity alternatives, and budget rebalancing
about.agentEnricherDesc: Adds practical local tips: weather advice, customs, safety notes, and money-saving alternatives
about.workflowTitle: How It Works — Behind the Scenes
about.workflowIntro: When you chat with VoyagerAI, a multi-agent orchestration unfolds in real-time:
about.step1Desc: The orchestrator chats with you to understand your destination, dates, budget, travel style, and group
about.step2Desc: Reads your saved preferences from persistent memory for personalized defaults
about.step3Desc: 5 subagent tasks launch simultaneously: accommodation, weather, sights, constraints, and risk detection
about.step4Desc: Multi-plan generator creates budget, balanced, and premium variants with cost breakdowns and tradeoffs
about.step5Desc: Validator checks plans against budget, constraints, and internal consistency
about.step6Desc: Quality scorer evaluates all 3 plans (0-100). Plans below 80 are automatically improved (max 2 iterations)
about.step7Desc: All 3 plans presented as interactive comparison cards with a side-by-side matrix
about.step8Desc: You pick your preferred tier — budget, balanced, or premium
about.step9Desc: The orchestrator refines your selected plan based on any additional requests
about.step10Desc: Each day is enriched with local tips, weather advice, and safety information
about.step11Desc: If over budget, the cost optimizer suggests alternatives for accommodation, activities, and transport
about.step12Desc: Learned preferences are saved back to persistent memory for future trips
about.step13Desc: The frontend renders your plan as an interactive timeline with map, budget tracking, and export options
about.flowSubtitle: The orchestrator dispatches specialized subagents in parallel for maximum efficiency
about.outro: Built on the deepagents framework with LangGraph for state management, LiteLLM for multi-provider LLM access, and Tavily for real-time internet search — all wrapped in a premium, responsive UI.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI-powered trip planning
faq.q1: How does AI generate my itinerary?
faq.a1: Tell us your destination, budget, travel style, and group size. AI creates a complete day-by-day plan with activities, transport, accommodation, and costs — all optimized for your preferences.
faq.a2: Yes! The travel planner is completely free to use. There are no hidden costs, subscriptions, or premium tiers.
faq.q3: Can I customize the itinerary after it's generated?
faq.a3: Absolutely. If a specific day doesn't match your expectations, you can use the "Replan This Day" feature to ask for changes. AI will regenerate that day while keeping the rest of your trip intact.
faq.q4: How accurate is the budget tracking?
faq.a4: AI estimates costs based on typical prices for each destination and activity type. The budget gauge shows you at a glance if you're within, over, or under your budget.
faq.a5: Any destination worldwide! From Tokyo to Timbuktu, AI has knowledge of destinations globally and can generate relevant itineraries.
faq.q6: How long does it take to generate a plan?
faq.a6: Most itineraries are generated in 10-20 seconds. Complex requests with many days may take slightly longer.
faq.q7: Can I save or share my itinerary?
faq.a7: Your itinerary is displayed on screen and can be copied or screenshotted. Save functionality coming soon.
faq.q8: What about dietary restrictions and accessibility?
faq.a8: You can specify dietary preferences and accessibility constraints in the form. AI takes these into account when planning activities and meal suggestions.
